name: zclass_node_get_pickable
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeGetPickable returns bit 5 of zClass node flags and preserves the null-node error behavior.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the zClass node flag accessor/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x448270 validates the null-node guard and output of (flags >> 5) & 1.
The native smoke toggles the pickable flag through the setter, reads it through the getter, and checks the null-node error return.
